about: The Workbench icons of the Mr.Boom drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own icon (Assets/hicolor/128x128/apps/mrboom.png). MrBoom-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, MrBoom.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's MrBoom.info. data.info is the sound and music drawer's.
